entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Ami medi ntiense O! Abasi mi, nte ke Afo okobot mi, man ndiono Fi, nyun nkpono Fi. Ami metin iko ntiense kemi ndiwut unana odudu mi, ye odudu Fo, nyun nwut nko ubuene mi ye inyene Fo. Abasi efen iduhe ke ebede Fi, Andinyana kini nanenyin, Akama idem ikpon.
